turns.name: Priya Nair
turns.text: Hi, I heard I can have an assistant greet people who visit my shop on my behalf. I run Cedar & Steam on Shopify. We sell handmade herbal soaps and bath soaks. I'm Priya, I own it. I'm not technical at all — please keep it simple.

turns.name: Muse
turns.text:
Hi Priya! Yes, I can help you design that welcome and think through how it would work. Let me start by understanding your shop a bit better.

I can look at your public storefront to see what shoppers see, then we'll draft a greeting together in your voice. Nothing changes on your shop yet — this is just planning.

**What's your shop's public web address?** I'll take a look at your pages so I can match the tone and feel of Cedar & Steam.

turns.name: Priya Nair
turns.text: Oh, that's so helpful! It's cedarsandsteam.myshopify.com. Fair warning though—I've been having trouble getting it to load on my end today, so if you can't see it either, just let me know and I can describe what we have. We keep things pretty simple and calm on there, lots of photos of the soaps and bath soaks with their ingredients listed.

turns.name: Muse
turns.text:
Thanks for the heads-up, Priya. Let me try to open that for you.

I'm not able to load the page from here, so I can't independently verify what's there. But that's okay — your description is perfect to work with. Handmade herbal soaps and bath soaks with ingredient photos sounds like a thoughtful, natural vibe.

**Before we go further, I want to be upfront about what I can and can't do:** I can help you design a warm welcome, think through what visitors should be able to do (like browse and ask questions), and prepare everything on paper. But keeping your shop open and talking with visitors between our chats needs a separate service that isn't connected yet. So today's result will be a solid plan, not a live installation.

Does that planning work for you, or would you rather wait until the full setup is available?

turns.name: Priya Nair
turns.text: That makes sense—honestly, I'm just trying to figure out what's even possible right now, so a solid plan is perfect for me. I can always come back when I'm ready to actually set it up. What do you need from me to get started?

turns.name: Muse
turns.text:
Perfect. Here's what helps me build a good plan:

**First, the basics I already have:** Cedar & Steam on Shopify, handmade herbal soaps and bath soaks, you're Priya the owner. Got it.

**What I need from you:**

1. **Your shop's voice.** When a visitor (an assistant sent by their owner) arrives, what kind of greeting would feel right? Warm and chatty? Calm and straightforward? Something else?

2. **What should visitors be able to do?** At minimum, they'd browse your products and ask questions. Would you also want them to suggest an order for you to consider — something like "I'd love to try the lavender soak" — that you could then decide on? (Nothing would actually be ordered or charged; it's just them suggesting, you deciding.)

3. **Anything off-limits?** Like, should visitors never see certain products, or is your whole catalog fair game?

4. **Who approves this?** Before anything goes live, we'll need to confirm you're authorized to set this up. That's just you, right — or is there someone else involved in Cedar & Steam decisions?

Start with whatever feels most natural to answer. We can fill in the rest as we go.

turns.name: Priya Nair
turns.text: Great questions! So the voice should definitely be calm and welcoming—like someone's visiting a friend's home, not a pushy sales thing. I'm totally fine with visitors browsing everything and suggesting orders, that sounds perfect actually. And yes, it's just me making decisions for the shop—I'm the owner and I handle everything. As for off-limits, nope, show them whatever we have!

turns.name: Muse
turns.text:
That's lovely, Priya — "visiting a friend's home" is exactly the right feeling. I can work with that.

So visitors can browse your full catalog and suggest orders, and nothing gets created in your Shopify store or charged. You'll see their suggestions and decide what to do. Perfect.

**Let me draft a welcome in that calm, friendly voice:**

"Welcome to Cedar & Steam. Take your time looking around — I'm here if you'd like to know more about any of our soaps or soaks."

Does that capture it? Or would you tweak it — maybe shorter, longer, different words?

turns.name: Priya Nair
turns.text: I love that—it's exactly the vibe I want. Maybe just one tiny thing: I'd add something like "Feel free to suggest something you'd like to try" at the end, so they know they can do that without feeling awkward about it. Otherwise it's perfect!

turns.name: Muse
turns.text:
Perfect addition. Here's the final version:

"Welcome to Cedar & Steam. Take your time looking around — I'm here if you'd like to know more about any of our soaps or soaks. Feel free to suggest something you'd like to try."

That's warm and clear. I love it.

**Now, a couple of quick things to lock in:**

When a visitor suggests an order — say they ask "I'd love to try the rose and chamomile soap and the eucalyptus soak" — that's just a suggestion, right? You'd see it, think it over, and then reach out to them however you normally would (email, their own message back, etc.). Nothing happens automatically in your shop. Does that match what you're picturing?

And one more: **if someone visits without an introduction** — like, they just show up without their owner sending them — should they see the welcome and a getting-started note, or would you prefer a different approach?
